# Phase Three — Thirty Final Refinements

1. Do not alter product code while deployment recovery is active.
2. Do not amend the already-tested product commit.
3. Keep deployment hardening as a separate commit.
4. Preserve the no-force push rule.
5. Preserve main-branch concurrency serialization.
6. Keep expected SHA sourced from GitHub, never caller text.
7. Quote every path and SHA expansion.
8. Reject malformed SHAs before SSH.
9. Make the helper fail closed on missing SHA.
10. Make the helper fail closed on missing repo.
11. Avoid printing environment secrets.
12. Avoid `set -x` in production deployment.
13. Print Git remote/branch state only if non-secret.
14. Bound fetch retries.
15. Never retry reset/activation implicitly.
16. Verify expected object after fetch before reset.
17. Verify origin/main after fetch before reset.
18. Preserve clean-tree requirement.
19. Preserve post-activation HEAD requirement.
20. Preserve homepage contract verification.
21. Preserve tunnel public-release verification.
22. Add Wallet canary only if it can be unauthenticated without leaking identity.
23. Keep helper source under 120 lines.
24. Keep workflow source under 120 lines by delegating remote logic.
25. Use exact blessing headers appropriate to YAML/shell.
26. Use tabs inside shell script indentation where syntactically safe.
27. Run `bash -n` on every touched shell file.
28. Re-read every touched deployment file after rewrite.
29. Re-fetch origin/main immediately before commit and push.
30. Declare live only after the GitHub run succeeds and the reconciliation canary no longer reports `INVALID_ROUTE`.
